title: GHG emissions disclosure
description: Disclosure that the seller will report greenhouse-gas emissions for fulfilling this order under a named accounting methodology and scope. The methodology is FREE-FORM — any standard, existing or future (e.g. "GHG Protocol Corporate Standard", "ISO 14064", "PAS 2050", "EN 16258", or a custom methodology). The protocol takes no closed list of standards. Pairs with the figaro-ghg-measurement runtime clause that carries the measured grams CO2e.

fields.name: standard
fields.label: Accounting methodology
fields.description: The GHG accounting methodology the seller reports under. Free-form — any methodology name, existing or future (e.g. "ISO 14064").
